flows.title: Create a feature flag
steps: Click Create and choose Flag. The Create flag dialog appears.
Enter a unique, human-readable Name. A key is suggested from it; click Edit key to change it now, because a saved flag key cannot be modified.

Optionally enter a Description, and click Custom to pick a flag template such as Release, Kill switch or Experiment. Without a template, select the type of Variations: boolean, string, number or JSON.
Click Create flag. The flag's Targeting tab appears.

flows.title: Turn a flag on
steps: In the left sidebar, click Code, then click Flags.
Click the name of the flag. Its Targeting tab opens.
Click the tab for the environment. If it is not shown, click + and select it from the list of environments.
Click the flag toggle. It turns green and reads On.

flows.title: Turn a flag off
steps: In the left sidebar, click Code, then click Flags.
Click the name of the flag, and on its Targeting tab click the tab for the environment.
Set the toggle to Off. The variation the flag will serve once saved is shown; its targeting rules stop applying.
